name: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins
description: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins has served Philadelphia musicians who need an instrument that sounds like them. Come play before you decide.

hero.headline: Violins chosen with a player in mind
hero.sub: Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins has served Philadelphia musicians who need an instrument that sounds like them. Come play before you decide.

story.heading: A shop for people who listen
paragraphs: You cannot judge a violin from a photo. Come in, play, and listen in the room.
We help students, professionals, and families who want the next instrument to last.
Frederick W. Oster Fine Violins serves people who live and work in Philadelphia.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

items: Leave with a sound you chose
experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: The room does the selling
feature.text: We keep the talk short so you can hear the instrument. If it is not right, we will say so.

spotlight.heading: Broad Street, Philadelphia
spotlight.text: The shop is on South Broad. Call ahead if you want a quiet hour with a few instruments out.

contact.heading: Come play something
contact.sub: Address and phone are here. Confirm hours on the official site before you travel.
